WITH retailer_scans AS (
    SELECT si.status_retailer_id AS retailer_id,
           SUM(qpm.box_calculation_uom) AS total_boxes_scanned
    FROM sku_inventories si
    JOIN sku_qr_points_maps qpm ON si.sku_code = qpm.sku_code
    JOIN users r ON si.status_retailer_id = r.id
    WHERE r.user_role = 2
      AND r.id = 50225
    GROUP BY si.status_retailer_id
),
retailer_earnings AS (
    SELECT u.id AS retailer_id,
           SUM(wt.amount) AS total_earnings
    FROM users u
    JOIN wallet_transaction wt ON u.id = wt.user_id
    WHERE u.user_role = 2
      AND u.id = 50225
      AND wt.reference_type IN ('topup','cash_point','referral_earning','coupon_redeem')
      AND wt.amount > 0
    GROUP BY u.id
),
retailer_details AS (
    SELECT r.id AS retailer_id,
           r.name AS retailer_name,
           r.email,
           r.mobile_number,
           r.address,
           r.city,
           r.district,
           d.id AS distributor_id,
           d.name AS distributor_name,
           s.state_name
    FROM users r
    LEFT JOIN retailer_distributor_mappings rdm ON rdm.retailer_id = r.id
    LEFT JOIN distributors d ON d.id = rdm.distributor_id
    LEFT JOIN states s ON s.id = r.state_id
    WHERE r.id = 50225
)
SELECT rd.retailer_id,
       rd.retailer_name,
       rd.email,
       rd.mobile_number,
       rd.address,
       rd.city,
       rd.district,
       rd.distributor_id,
       rd.distributor_name,
       rd.state_name,
       COALESCE(rs.total_boxes_scanned,0) AS total_boxes_scanned,
       COALESCE(re.total_earnings,0) AS total_earnings
FROM retailer_details rd
LEFT JOIN retailer_scans rs ON rd.retailer_id = rs.retailer_id
LEFT JOIN retailer_earnings re ON rd.retailer_id = re.retailer_id
